lines.1: Come to think of it, Fukahire hadn't shown his face all week.
lines.2: His cell phone wasn't connecting. He probably hadn't paid the bill.
lines.3: Oh, right. He played an online game, didn't he?
lines.4: I was still on an old-fashioned dial-up connection, so the lag had made me quit almost immediately.
lines.6: His handle was Shark, if I remembered right.
lines.7: I'd ask the other players in the tavern.
